name: The Search Continues
summary: The search for the Menethil Statuette continues among nearby Murloc hovels. This cluster holds no sign of it, so you look toward two more shelters.

sections.title: Empty Hovels
sections.body: You search this cluster of Murloc hovels, but find no trace of the Menethil Statuette. The nearby hovels to the north and northeast may hold more clues.

faq.answer: You are searching for the Menethil Statuette.

faq.q: What do I find in these hovels?
faq.answer: You find no trace of the Menethil Statuette in this cluster of Murloc hovels.
Two nearby hovels to the north and northeast may hold more clues.
The barrel contains damp, pungent cheese that is still tasty.
